title: Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei on the Mecca Agreement:
text:
Iran's FM Spox. Esmaeil Baqaei on the Mecca Agreement:"

"There is no reason for us to be concerned that this pact between the two neighboring countries of Türkiye and Pakistan, as well as Saudi Arabia—three countries with which we share deep religious, historical, and civilizational bonds—is directed against Iran."

"The history of friendship between the nations of Türkiye and Pakistan, as two neighboring Muslim countries, is long-standing. "

"This development is an important sign [of a shift in regional perceptions]."
